One of Tibia's most famous quests: descend to the {wiki:Pits of Inferno|Pits of Inferno}, beneath the Plains of Havoc, cross the Hall of the Five Ways with a team of all vocations, solve the levers, the spa and the maze and enter the throne rooms of the {wiki:Ruthless Seven|Ruthless Seven}. Absorb the spirit of the seven thrones to open the treasure room, where you receive {item:Soft Boots}, {item:Backpack of Holding}, {item:Stuffed Dragon}, {item:Frozen Starlight}, 100 platinum coins and choose between {item:Arcane Staff}, {item:Avenger} or {item:Arbalest}.
Plains of Havoc graveyard cave (use the Pick here)
Shortcut (Hub Shortcut) from the Necromant House to the main room of the Pits of Inferno
As soon as you **enter** a Ruthless Seven throne room (you don't need to complete it).
The teleport is behind a {item:Sealed Door|sealed door}, one floor above the Necromant House ground floor.
Mission 7 of The Inquisition Quest (Demon Forge)
When you absorb the spirit of at least one of the {wiki:The Ruthless Seven|Ruthless Seven}.
You also must have reported Ungreez's mission in the Inquisition.
